description: BinarizedTargetMeanValue-CTR end-to-end isolation (E13 / A2). Categorical-ONLY feature matrix (two columns, cardinality 6 and 5, zero float columns) so upstream float-quantization nondeterminism is structurally excluded. one_hot_max_size=1 routes both columns to the CTR path. simple_ctr=BinarizedTargetMeanValue with combinations_ctr=[] and max_ctr_complexity=1 isolates the simple BTMV type: a read-before-increment prefix over TCtrMeanHistory whose Sum is accumulated in f32. model.cbm is committed here and is reused by E18/E19 as the upstream BTMV .cbm the decoder must load. NEVER regenerated in CI.

npy_schema.X_cat.npy: [N,2] int32 — categorical codes (stringified A4 form on the Rust side)
npy_schema.model.cbm: upstream BTMV .cbm — the E18/E19 decoder fixture

note: FROZEN. Generated once by this directory's own gen_fixtures.py and NEVER regenerated in CI. Regenerating invalidates the <=1e-5 gate.
